note: Datasets the export ships with geometry belonging to a different place. Filtered out of the manifest by datasets.ts, skipped by update-data's mirrors, and exempt from the placement audit in check:datasets. Remove an entry once a corrected export lands — update-data samples the file's bounds and reports when one is no longer needed. It cannot report an entry the export has *withdrawn* rather than fixed: with no file there is nothing to sample, so a withdrawal shows up only as the city losing the tool in check:coverage. The 2026-09-24 export withdrew aalborg_dk, aarhus_dk, copenhagen_dk and vejle_dk that way; their entries are removed here and the four are tracked as superblockify coverage gaps instead.

excluded.reason: Export holds Nikopol, Bulgaria (24.9E 43.7N), not Nikopol, Ukraine — a place-name collision.
